# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a narrow opening range (volatility compression), a breakout on rising volume and expanding VIX signals a directional move with follow-through. The edge exists because low volatility periods often precede expansion moves, and volume/VIX confirmation filters for genuine institutional participation rather than random noise.

## Mechanism

Define opening range (first 30 min) high and low. If the range width is below the 20-day average of opening range width (volatility compression), wait for price to break above the opening range high (long) or below the opening range low (short) on a candle with volume > 2x the average volume of the first 30 min and current VIX > previous close VIX (rising volatility); enter at the breakout candle close. Exit: Stop at the opposite side of the opening range (e.g., for long breakout, stop at opening range low); target at 2x the opening range width added to the breakout point, or trail using a premium-stop % (e.g., 15% of ATR) after 1R.
